drone_interaction.vision_modality: Stereo RGB-NIR ripeness classification (identifying dark purple/black berries vs green/red)
drone_interaction.harvest_tool: Mantis soft silicone dual pinch rollers with high-precision micro-shears & vacuum cushioned collection pod

exhaustive_medicinal_and_bioactive_compo.bioactive_mechanisms: Competitive inhibition of intestinal alpha-glucosidase (maltase and sucrase)
exhaustive_medicinal_and_bioactive_compo.human_therapeutic_efficacy: Suppresses postprandial hyperglycemia and reduces glycemic variability
exhaustive_medicinal_and_bioactive_compo.extraction_or_utilization: Present in berries and leaves; consumed fresh or dried into tea

exhaustive_medicinal_and_bioactive_compo.bioactive_mechanisms: Direct vascular endothelial nitric oxide stimulation and potent reactive oxygen scavenging
exhaustive_medicinal_and_bioactive_compo.human_therapeutic_efficacy: Microvascular protection, enhanced ocular circulation, and anti-inflammatory activity
exhaustive_medicinal_and_bioactive_compo.extraction_or_utilization: Direct dietary consumption of fresh dark berries

penalties_and_risks: Requires rigid horizontal espalier wires for robotic traction and branch indexing.
Soft berry drupelets bruise if gripper force exceeds 1.2 N; requires cushioned vacuum catch pod.
human_culinary_use: Sweet, rich berry flavor with mild acidity. Consumed fresh as dessert fruit, simmered into preserves, or dehydrated into chewy fruit bars.
